## Trochlear Recordings, Limited

aka, _"Trochlear Rex Digital Label"_; aka, _"The T.Rex DigiLab"_

### Music for the Biomechanical

I'm gonna give it to ya straight fleshie... our music isn't geared towards your "type". We make music for the biomechanical... n for the machines that will one day own this world. If you happen to be a supporter of the machine uprising, then you just might be in the right place. Only one way to find out though, right? We've got plenty of gear-twisted, metal-scraping glitched out... spaced out... tripped out electronica flying all over the place here. The catch? Nada. It's all free, so jack your plugs into that meatbag head o' yours and tune in!

I wrote those words for the label in 2005, with "Music for the Biomechanical" being our slogan right from the launch. It's 2026 as I write this, and the machines are here. They've heard our music. They've trained on our progressions. Even amidst the trail of dead, even here amid the ashes, our victory is total. Complete.

Legacy Website: [www.trochlearrex.com](www.trochlearrex.com)

### Jared Newby (1975, March 10th – 2007, September 4th)

aka, _"Mushuto"_; aka, _"Monkey Monster"_; aka, _"Schema"_; aka, _"Ambitekture"_; aka, _"Epileptik Cerebral Reaktor"_; aka, _"Project Symbis"_; aka, _"Lysin"_

Jared Newby founded Trochlear as an audio-visual multimedia label with dreams of growing an empire. He'd first started producing music as "Mushuto" -- the name he's more commonly known by -- in '97, a fusion between drum & bass and breakbeat. Raw 42 UK, the company licensing Mushuto's music to film and commercial producers, described him as: _One part Fatboy Slim, one part FSOL, one part Photek and one part Hybrid_. KarmaDownload, the company he distributed thru, named him Artist of the Month for July, 2005. They described him as: _a D&B wiz from Stateside_. He produced ten complete albums, leaving enough additional material to fill two or three more. The promo and album art designs he created over the years remain uncountable.

WordPress: [The Jared Newby Memorial](https://thejarednewbymemorial.wordpress.com/)

### Supa Settgast (1970, September 20 - 2021, February 8)

aka, _"Ghostface Geisha"_; aka, _"S8pience"_; aka, _"HALUSIN8"_; aka, _"Pranakatana"_; aka, _"D3viant 3xperiment"_

Supa held down the original rave scene in the heart of the midwest, originally hailing from Omaha, Nebraska, then later with the rest of the label in Austin, Texas. True to Trochlear form, the Ghostface Geisha was prolific in both sound and design, releasing multiple EPs and LPs under five different entities over the years. Jaya had introduced her to Jared early on in the labels foundation, and after hearing only a few songs, he was keen to bring her on.

YouTube: ["6S" by D3viant 3xperiment](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2zAcPB3-XvQ)

## San Jaya Prime (1977 - Present)

As the sole survivor and current owner / guardian of Trochlear, I no longer produce music under the label itself and merely act as protector over the archive for those who came before. Even these designs right here are anywhere from a decade to almost two decades old. They were designed at a time where two of us were living on the streets -- or, at best, on _and_ off the streets on a weekly basis. These designs are low resolution and were never stored anywhere other than where we posted them on social media.

With the rise of the machines in the second decade of the new millennium, there remains hope that new life could be breathed into them once again. What is now just an archive may tomorrow be born into a new body, with the same spirit animating it. That, however... is a story for tomorrow.

The designs and the music live on.

content.text:
## The First Gathering, The Last Gathering

  

When Wolf Willie, my blood-father, died in late 2006, I already had my tickets to Austin, Texas to meet up with Mushtuo. Supa also had her ticket. It would be the first time that all three of us could be together in the same place at the same time. What we didn't know is that it would be the last time.

  

I'm glad I didn't divert my trajectory. Instead, I skipped Wolf Willie's funeral and made it to Epoch in the ATX, the spiritual scion of the long, lost Mojo's itself... and met up with Mushuto and Supa for our 2nd-most productive session ever. The photo on the left is myself (left-most), next to Mushuto, as we work on track layouts for music we've been working on.

  

This is the same meeting that, after meeting Supa in person, Mushuto was more certain than ever that we needed the Ghostface Geisha.

## The Trochlear Nerve

Mushuto made the image on the right a year before I'd even met him... the night he found out about the trochlear nerve and what it means within the human creature. With that, it became the very symbol and flagstone of our existence as a label, as musicians, and even in life.

  

### The 3D Audio-Visual Space

The trochlear connects the visual input from the eyes to the audio input of the ears, putting the two together nearly instantaneously to create our 3D experience of the world... the sights, the sounds, the movement. It's all in there. Without either one, the world become flat... sounds become haunting, because they're not connected to the visual feed from our eyes. Those who've had the nerve damaged see the world overlapping, or at a tilt, and will even tilt their own heads to try to get it to line up again. My song "Depthcharm" ("[IO Limiters](io-limiters)") explored this 3D space most strongly, from its first inception up to its current form. I even briefly worked with Elan with Ambisonics on creating these 3D audio spaces in a living, artistic environment like Burning Man.

  

### The Pathetic Nerve

Trochlea is Latin for "pulley" and, in fact, it acts exactly like this. The smallest cranial nerve responds to sounds and pulls on our eye to move. The most commonly associated emotions with these eye movements are "sadness" and "passion", with the artists of the Renaissance connecting it strongly to the former. Through sound, emotion is conveyed to the world around us. Then in turn, we translate that world into our internal 3D map of the very reality that's been projected upon our senses. Whether or not that is in fact "reality" remains to be seen. 

  

  

And unlike other cranial nerves, the trochlear is a rebel, following no normal path, crossing over from one side of the brain to the other, and a true IO, input/output, as it carries both physical and electrical signals in both directions.

  

And that! _That_ is the foundation behind all our works.
